title: Tekken's Harada roasts Xbox Series S at Seoul panel 🎮
subject: xbox
description:
Should Microsoft make another Series S? 👇

Former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada, now CEO of SNK's VS Studio, criticized the Xbox Series S at the Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul, citing low memory and 'awkwardly lower' performance than Series X. Microsoft has not responded.

Sources: Inven Global (via Kotaku, Nov 11, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 11, 2026), Shacknews (Nov 11, 2026), Gamereactor (Nov 12, 2026)
Game footage © Bandai Namco Entertainment.

scenes.text: Katsuhiro Harada wants no more consoles like the Series S.
The former Tekken boss joined a five-developer panel at the 2026 Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul.
With a senior Xbox official watching, he wished hardware like the Series S wouldn't be released.
His complaint: low memory, and performance awkwardly below the nearly identical Series X.
He called it extra work for a slightly weaker child.
Pawel Sasko of CD Projekt Red said it forces cleaner code. Microsoft has not responded.
